q: 限流器基础设计的需求范围，哪些正确？
options: 配置只在系统启动时加载一次
请求只携带 clientId 和 endpoint 两个字符串
每个 endpoint 可以指定不同算法和参数
结果包含 allowed、remaining、retryAfterMs 三个字段
支持运行时动态更新已加载的配置
options_en: Configuration is loaded exactly once at startup.
A request carries only two strings: clientId and endpoint.
Each endpoint can specify its own algorithm and parameters.
The result has three fields: allowed, remaining, retryAfterMs.
The system supports hot-reloading configuration at runtime.
why: 基础设计把配置加载、请求输入、endpoint 策略和结构化结果先固定下来；运行时热更新会引入原子替换或保状态更新，不在这版范围内。
why_en: The base design fixes startup config, simple request keys, per-endpoint policies, and structured results; hot reload is out of scope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 唯一标识发起请求客户端的字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clientId is the string that uniquely identifies the caller making a request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被限流的 API 路径标识，用作查配置的 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: endpoint is the API path used as the lookup key for its rate-limit config.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求被拒绝时，建议客户端等待多少毫秒后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: retryAfterMs tells a denied caller how many milliseconds to wait before retrying.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务不重启的情况下加载并应用新配置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hot reload applies new configuration without restarting the service.

q_en: Which requirements are in scope for the base rate limiter design? (Select all that apply.)
optionExplanations: 启动时读一次配置就够，构造阶段可以直接创建好所有 limiter，不用为运行中 reload 铺路。
clientId 和 endpoint 这两个字符串就是查表和限流 key 的全部输入，不需要更复杂的请求对象。
algorithm 字段按 endpoint 区分，Factory 才能给不同 endpoint 建不同的 Limiter 实现。
allowed/remaining/retryAfterMs 一起返回，调用方才能设置响应头、显示剩余额度和重试提示。
热更新配置属于后续扩展题——基础版本里配置只在启动时加载，改这条会牵出原子替换或保状态更新的复杂度。
optionExplanations_en: Startup-only config load means the constructor can create every limiter once, with no live-reload path to build for.
clientId and endpoint are the only two strings needed to look up a policy and key a limiter — nothing more elaborate.
The algorithm field varies per endpoint, so the factory builds a different Limiter for each one.
allowed, remaining, and retryAfterMs travel together so callers can set headers, show quota, or hint a retry.
Hot-reloading config is a later extension — the base design loads config once at startup, and adding this pulls in atomic swap or state-preserving update complexity.
scenario: 45 分钟白板题：单机 Java 进程内限流器，只做能跑通的最小版本，扩展项留到 follow-up。
scenario_en: A 45-minute whiteboard task: an in-process rate limiter for one Java service, minimum working version only, extensions deferred to follow-ups.

scenario: 请求只以 clientId 和 endpoint 两个字符串进入系统，处理后立即用于查 limiter 和 key。
scenario_en: Requests enter only as clientId and endpoint strings, then immediately route to a limiter and key.
q: Request/Client/Endpoint 应如何建模？
q_en: How should Request, Client, and Endpoint be modeled?
options: 都保持为输入字符串或 key，不建实体
三者都建成复杂类
Endpoint 继承 Limiter
Client 保存所有算法状态
options_en: Keep all three as plain input strings or lookup keys — no entity classes.
Turn all three into full-blown classes.
Make Endpoint inherit from Limiter.
Let Client hold all algorithm state.
why: 这些对象在系统内没有生命周期或行为。真正有状态的是具体 Limiter 的 per-key 记录。
why_en: Request, client, and endpoint are input keys, while limiter implementations own the rate-limit state.
whenOtherWins: 如果要管理客户端套餐、endpoint 元数据或请求上下文，才可能新增实体。
tradeoff: 建实体便于未来扩展 vs YAGNI 精简（无行为就不建类）

termDefinitions.meaning: “你不会需要它”，即不要为不存在的需求预先构建功能的设计原则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI stands for "you aren't gonna need it," meaning don't build for requirements that don't exist yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is state tracked independently for each key.

optionExplanations: clientId/endpoint 没有行为也没有生命周期，直接当 map key 用就够，不用为它们建实体类。
假设每个名词都得有类，会造出三个没有行为的空壳类，违反 YAGNI。
把纯标签误当成算法子类型——Endpoint 和 Limiter 语义完全不同，继承在这里是误用。
把 per-key 算法状态错放进 Client，会让 Client 要感知每种算法的字段，职责被搞乱。
optionExplanations_en: clientId and endpoint have no behavior or lifecycle, so they stay plain lookup keys instead of becoming entity classes.
This assumes every noun needs a class, producing three empty shells that violate YAGNI.
This treats a plain label as an algorithm subtype — Endpoint and Limiter mean completely different things, so inheritance misuses it here.
This puts per-key algorithm state in Client, forcing it to know every algorithm's fields and blurring ownership.

q_en: Which core types are in the final design? (Select all that apply.)
options: RateLimiter
Limiter interface
LimiterFactory
RateLimitResult
TokenBucketLimiter / SlidingWindowLogLimiter
Client 类持有该用户的完整请求历史
options_en: RateLimiter.
Limiter interface.
LimiterFactory.
RateLimitResult.
TokenBucketLimiter / SlidingWindowLogLimiter.
A Client class holds the user's full request history.
why: 编排、算法契约、创建、结果封装、具体实现各占一个类型；把用户的请求历史挂到 Client 上会放错状态所有者。
why_en: The five real types cover orchestration, the algorithm contract, creation, the result object, and concrete algorithms, while Client is deliberately not modeled as an entity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统入口/编排类，负责按 endpoint 路由到具体 Limiter。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RateLimiter is the entry-point class that routes each request to the right Limiter implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一的限流算法接口，只有 allow(key) 一个方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Limiter is the common interface every rate-limiting algorithm implements, with a single allow(key) method.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据配置中的 algorithm 字段创建具体 Limiter 实例的工厂类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LimiterFactory reads the algorithm field in config and instantiates the matching Limiter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 封装 allowed/remaining/retryAfterMs 的不可变结果对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RateLimitResult is an immutable value object packaging the allowed flag, remaining quota, and retry time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。

optionExplanations: RateLimiter 是请求进来的编排入口，按 endpoint 路由到具体 Limiter。
Limiter 只暴露 allow(key) 一个方法，是所有算法共用的契约。
LimiterFactory 把配置解析和具体类创建集中到一处，新增算法不用碰其他类。
RateLimitResult 是不可变值对象，封装 allowed/remaining/retryAfterMs。
TokenBucketLimiter 和 SlidingWindowLogLimiter 是两个并列实现，各自管好自己那份逐 key 数据。
把请求历史放进 Client 放错了所有者——它不该管理任何算法状态，那是各 Limiter 实现自己的事。
optionExplanations_en: RateLimiter is the entry point that routes each incoming request to the right Limiter.
Limiter exposes just one method, allow(key) — the single contract every algorithm implements.
LimiterFactory centralizes config parsing and object creation, so adding an algorithm never touches other classes.
RateLimitResult is an immutable value object packaging allowed, remaining, and retryAfterMs.
TokenBucketLimiter and SlidingWindowLogLimiter are the two concrete algorithms, each owning its own per-key state.
This puts request history in Client, the wrong owner — algorithm state belongs to each Limiter implementation, not Client.
scenario: 限流器要支持多种算法、每个 endpoint 各配一种，现在给这版设计定最终类清单。
scenario_en: The limiter must support several algorithms with a different one per endpoint, and you are settling the final class list.

q: 为什么 Limiter 用 interface 而不是抽象基类共享状态？
q_en: Why use a Limiter interface instead of an abstract base class with shared state?
options: 不同算法的 per-key 状态完全不同，抽象基类不会有共享字段
假设 Java 语法完全不支持抽象类这种机制
误以为 interface 能自动帮你解析配置字段
误以为所有算法都必须共用同一个 timestamp 队列结构
options_en: Different algorithms need completely different per-key state, so an abstract base class would have no shared fields.
This assumes Java's language syntax does not support abstract classes at all.
This mistakenly assumes an interface can auto-parse config fields.
This mistakenly assumes every algorithm must share one timestamp queue structure.
why: 两种算法的 per-key 字段完全不重叠，能提到基类里的共享成员一个都没有，抽象基类只会是空壳。
why_en: Limiter is an interface because algorithms have different per-key state and only share the allow contract, so a base class would carry no shared fields.
tradeoff: interface：零共享但形状统一 vs 抽象基类：可共享字段但常是空壳

termDefinitions.meaning: 只声明方法契约、不含状态实现的类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An interface declares a method contract without holding shared state or implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 可以包含共享字段和默认实现、且不能直接实例化的父类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An abstract base class can hold shared fields and default logic and cannot be instantiated directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is state tracked independently for each key.

optionExplanations: TokenBucket 要 tokens/lastRefillTime，SlidingWindowLog 要 timestamp queue，两者没有可提取的公共字段。
把设计选择误判成语言限制——Java 完全支持抽象类，只是这里没必要用。
把配置解析的职责错放到接口上——那其实是 Factory 该干的事。
把一种算法的队列状态硬套给所有算法，TokenBucket 会被迫持有它用不到的队列。
optionExplanations_en: TokenBucket needs tokens/lastRefillTime while SlidingWindowLog needs a timestamp queue — the two share no extractable field.
This mistakes a design choice for a language limit — Java fully supports abstract classes, it's just unnecessary here.
This puts config-parsing duty on the interface, when that job actually belongs to the factory.
This forces one algorithm's queue state onto every algorithm, so TokenBucket would carry a queue it never uses.
scenario: 限流器要同时容纳令牌计数和时间戳队列两种形状完全不同的 per-key 状态。
scenario_en: The limiter has to host two completely different shapes of per-key state: a token count and a timestamp queue.

scenario: 配置 JSON 中 algorithm 字段可能是 TokenBucket 或 SlidingWindowLog，参数结构不同。
scenario_en: The config JSON has an algorithm field, either TokenBucket or SlidingWindowLog, and each algorithm has different parameters.
q: 创建具体 Limiter 的逻辑应放在哪里？
q_en: Where should the logic for creating concrete Limiters live?
options: LimiterFactory.create()
RateLimitResult 构造函数
每次 allow() 的调用点里 switch
clientId 字符串的工具方法
options_en: LimiterFactory.create().
Inside the RateLimitResult constructor.
A switch statement at every allow() call site.
A utility method on the clientId string.
why: Factory 集中处理异构配置和算法类型选择。RateLimiter 构造时只调用 factory，不散落 switch。
why_en: LimiterFactory centralizes runtime creation of the right limiter implementation from heterogeneous config.
whenOtherWins: 如果算法可插件化增长很多，可把 switch 演进成 registry pattern。
tradeoff: 创建逻辑集中在 Factory vs 散落在各调用点重复 switch

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据配置中的 algorithm 字段创建具体 Limiter 实例的工厂类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LimiterFactory reads the algorithm field in config and instantiates the matching Limiter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 配置里用来判断该创建哪个具体类型的字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A discriminator is the config field used to decide which concrete type to instantiate.

optionExplanations: 创建逻辑集中在专门的 Factory 里，config 结构一变只需要改这一处。
把创建逻辑塞进结果值对象——Result 应该只读不可变，不该决定创建哪种算法。
把 switch 撒在每个调用点，一旦要加新算法就得到处改，难维护。
clientId 只是限流 key，跟创建哪个 Limiter 完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: Creation logic lives in one dedicated factory, so a config shape change only touches this one place.
This buries creation logic in the result object — Result should stay read-only, not decide which algorithm to build.
This scatters a switch across every call site, so adding an algorithm means editing everywhere.
clientId is just the rate-limit key, unrelated to which Limiter gets created.

scenario: RateLimiter 收到 allow(clientId, endpoint)，需要找到该 endpoint 的策略。
scenario_en: RateLimiter receives allow(clientId, endpoint) and needs to find the policy for that endpoint.
q: RateLimiter 应保存哪些核心状态？
q_en: What core state should RateLimiter keep?
options: endpoint→Limiter 的 Map，加一个 defaultLimiter
把所有 client 的 bucket 状态都放在 RateLimiter 里
维护一份跨所有 client 的全局请求历史列表
把所有 endpoint 名字拼接成一个大字符串
options_en: A Map from endpoint to Limiter, plus one defaultLimiter.
Store every client's bucket state directly inside RateLimiter.
Keep one global request-history list across all clients.
Concatenate all endpoint names into one big string.
why: 具体 per-client 状态由各 Limiter 自己管理。RateLimiter 只负责 endpoint 到 limiter 的路由和 default fallback。
why_en: RateLimiter stores endpoint-to-limiter routing plus a default limiter, while algorithms own per-client state.
whenOtherWins: 如果每个未知 endpoint 需要独立配额，可懒创建各自的 default-config limiter。
tradeoff: endpoint 路由信息 vs per-client 算法状态该归谁管
diagram:
classDiagram
  class RateLimiter
  class Limiter
  class RateLimitConfig
  class RateLimitResult
  RateLimiter --> Limiter
  RateLimiter --> RateLimitConfig
  Limiter --> RateLimitResult

termDefinitions.meaning: 未配置 endpoint 时使用的兜底 Limiter 实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: defaultLimiter is the fallback Limiter instance used when an endpoint has no specific config.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一的限流算法接口，只有 allow(key) 一个方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Limiter is the common interface every rate-limiting algorithm implements, with a single allow(key) method.

optionExplanations: endpoint 路由表加一个兜底 limiter 就够，查表 O(1)，具体算法状态留给各 Limiter 自己管。
把算法内部状态搬进编排层，RateLimiter 就得理解每种算法的字段，职责会混乱。
全局共享一份历史会让不同 client 的请求互相干扰，限流直接失效。
把结构化路由压成字符串，查询时还得再解析一遍，纯粹多此一举。
optionExplanations_en: A routing map plus one fallback limiter is enough — lookup is O(1), and each Limiter owns its own algorithm state.
This moves algorithm-internal state into the orchestration layer, forcing RateLimiter to know every algorithm's fields.
A single shared history mixes different clients' requests together, breaking rate limiting outright.
This flattens structured routing into a string that has to be re-parsed on every lookup — pure overhead.

q: 补全 RateLimitResult 字段语义：
q_en: Fill in the meaning of the RateLimitResult fields:
text: RateLimitResult 包含 {{allowed}}、{{remaining}}、{{retryAfterMs}}；retryAfterMs 在允许时为 {{null}}，拒绝时为等待毫秒数。
why: 结构化结果比单纯 boolean 更有用：调用方能设置响应头、显示剩余额度或提示重试时间。
why_en: RateLimitResult packages the decision with remaining quota and retry timing so callers can set response headers or show a retry hint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次请求是否被放行的布尔值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: allowed is the boolean flag stating whether this request was let through.

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理完当前请求后，调用方还剩多少可用额度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: remaining is how much quota the caller has left after this request is processed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求被拒绝时，建议客户端等待多少毫秒后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: retryAfterMs tells a denied caller how many milliseconds to wait before retrying.

q: 为什么 retryAfterMs 不用 0 表示“无需等待”？
q_en: Why not use 0 in retryAfterMs to mean "no wait needed"?
options: null 表示"不适用"，0 是真实的等待值
误以为 JSON 格式根本没办法表示数字 0 这个值
误以为毫秒数必须转成字符串才能返回
误以为可以省略 allowed 这个布尔字段
options_en: null means "not applicable," while 0 would be a real wait value.
This mistakenly assumes JSON has no way to represent the number zero at all.
This mistakenly assumes milliseconds must be returned as a string.
This mistakenly assumes the allowed boolean field can be dropped.
why: 字段名带 Ms 明确单位，null 表示成功请求没有 retry 概念。用 0 当哨兵值会让语义含糊。
why_en: A nullable retryAfterMs is clearer than using zero as a sentinel value, because zero could be misread as "retry immediately."
tradeoff: 显式 null 语义 vs 用 0 当哨兵值带来的歧义风险

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求被拒绝时，建议客户端等待多少毫秒后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: retryAfterMs tells a denied caller how many milliseconds to wait before retrying.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个特殊数值代表'无意义'状态的技巧，容易和真实数值混淆。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sentinel value overloads a special number to mean "not applicable," which is easy to confuse with a real value.

optionExplanations: null 专门表达“这次没有等待概念”，跟“0ms 马上能重试”区分开，语义不含糊。
把 JSON 数字能力理解错了——0 本来就是合法的 JSON 数字，这不是用 null 的理由。
把单位清晰度和数据类型搞混——字段名已经带 Ms 后缀，不需要转字符串。
想用一个字段替代放行判断——没有 allowed，调用方还得靠猜。
optionExplanations_en: null specifically means "not applicable," keeping it distinct from "0ms, retry right now."
This misreads JSON's numeric support — zero is already a valid JSON number, so that's not the real reason.
This confuses unit clarity with data type — the Ms suffix already states the unit, no string needed.
This tries to make one field replace the allow decision — without allowed, callers are left guessing.
scenario: 结果对象直接喂给 HTTP 层：放行时不写等待时间，拒绝时要把毫秒数放进 Retry-After 头。
scenario_en: The result object feeds the HTTP layer directly: allowed responses carry no wait, denied ones put milliseconds into a Retry-After header.

scenario: 实现 Factory 时，config 包含 algorithm 和 algoConfig。
scenario_en: When implementing the factory, config contains algorithm and algoConfig.
q: 这段伪代码体现了什么模式？
q_en: What pattern does this pseudocode demonstrate?
codeSample:
create(config)
    algorithm = config['algorithm']
    algo = config['algoConfig']
    switch algorithm
        case 'TokenBucket':
            return TokenBucketLimiter(algo['capacity'], algo['refillRatePerSecond'])
        case 'SlidingWindowLog':
            return SlidingWindowLogLimiter(algo['maxRequests'], algo['windowMs'])
        default:
            throw UnknownAlgorithm
options: 按配置 discriminator 创建具体 Limiter
误以为每次请求都要重新创建 limiter
误以为 RateLimitResult 负责解析配置
误以为 SlidingWindowLog 继承 TokenBucket
options_en: A factory builds the right Limiter from a config discriminator.
This mistakenly assumes a limiter must be recreated on every request.
This mistakenly assumes RateLimitResult parses configuration.
This mistakenly assumes SlidingWindowLog inherits from TokenBucket.
why: algorithm 字段是 discriminator，Factory 抽取对应参数并实例化实现。未知算法要 fail fast。
why_en: The factory uses the algorithm discriminator to instantiate the correct limiter with algorithm-specific parameters.
whenOtherWins: 当算法由外部插件注册时，可用 registry 替代 switch。
tradeoff: 运行时按 discriminator 选实现 vs 到处写 if/switch 分支创建

termDefinitions.meaning: 配置里用来判断该创建哪个具体类型的字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A discriminator is the config field used to decide which concrete type to instantiate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把'根据类型创建哪个具体实现'集中到一个类里的创建型模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The factory pattern centralizes the logic for creating the right concrete implementation from input data.

optionExplanations: 一次 switch 按类型标记建出对应的 Limiter 类，是标准的 Factory 写法。
把创建时机和请求处理搞混——limiter 已在构造函数里 eager 建好，不该每请求重建。
把解析配置的职责错放进结果对象——Result 只读不可变，不该做解析工作。
把两个平行算法误建成继承关系——它们 per-key state 完全不同，继承只会是空壳。
optionExplanations_en: One switch builds the matching Limiter class from the type tag — a standard factory shape.
This confuses creation timing with request handling — limiters are already eagerly built in the constructor.
This puts config-parsing duty on the result object, when Result should stay read-only.
This forces an inheritance relation between two parallel algorithms that share no per-key state at all.

scenario: 系统启动时配置了几十个 endpoint。
scenario_en: At startup, the system has a few dozen configured endpoints.
q: 为什么构造时 eager 创建所有 limiters 合理？
q_en: Why is eager creation of all limiters reasonable in the constructor?
options: 端点数不大，eager 创建省掉懒创建的加锁
误以为每个请求都必须重新创建 limiter
误以为 eager 创建会自动清理内存
误以为 lazy 创建在技术上无法实现
options_en: Endpoint counts are small, so eager creation skips lazy-init locking.
This mistakenly assumes a limiter must be recreated on every request.
This mistakenly assumes eager creation automatically frees memory.
This mistakenly assumes lazy creation is technically impossible.
why: 启动配置固定，几十到几百个小对象内存成本低，eager 初始化不需要处理并发首次创建，更容易推理。
why_en: Eager limiter creation is simpler and cheap for typical endpoint counts, and it avoids synchronizing concurrent first-time creation.
whenOtherWins: 如果有数千 endpoint 且大多数没有流量，lazy creation 才可能值得。
tradeoff: 启动时一次性创建、无需加锁 vs 首次请求才创建、需处理并发初始化

termDefinitions.meaning: 启动时就把所有对象提前创建好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eager creation builds every object up front at startup instead of on demand.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只有第一次用到时才创建对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lazy creation builds an object only the first time it is actually needed.

optionExplanations: 几十到几百个 endpoint 内存成本可忽略，启动时一次建好还省掉了首次并发创建的加锁逻辑。
把 limiter 当成一次性对象——重建会丢失 per-key 状态，限流直接失效。

optionExplanations: 复用启动时的 Factory 创建逻辑重建整份 limiter map，再整体原子替换，能接受状态清空的前提下最简单。
在无保护情况下改运行中的共享对象——并发请求可能读到修改到一半的字段。
假装配置更新没发生——配置服务推送的新规则会永远不生效。
把配置加载和请求处理路径混在一起——每请求读文件的 IO 开销和已知需求矛盾。
optionExplanations_en: It reuses the same startup factory logic to rebuild every limiter, then swaps the whole map in atomically — simplest when a state reset is acceptable.
This edits a running shared object with zero protection — concurrent requests could read a half-updated field.
This pretends the config push never happened — the new rules would never take effect.

q: reloadConfig 全量替换的最大缺点是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest drawback of full reloadConfig replacement?
options: 所有 client 的 token/窗口历史被清空，滥用者也跟着重置
误以为 reloadConfig 没办法切换到别的算法
误以为 reloadConfig 无法新增一个 endpoint
误以为重建 limiter 会让 Result 变成空值
options_en: Every client's token/window history is wiped, giving abusive clients a fresh start too.
This mistakenly assumes reloadConfig cannot switch to a different algorithm.
This mistakenly assumes reloadConfig cannot add a new endpoint.
This mistakenly assumes rebuilding limiters makes Result null.
why: 状态丢失有时可接受，但降低限额或防滥用时，让滥用者拿到 fresh start 会破坏更新的目的。
why_en: Full reload loses per-key limiter history, which is acceptable sometimes but defeats the purpose when tightening limits against abuse.
tradeoff: 重建简单直接 vs per-key 状态连续性被牺牲

termDefinitions.meaning: 重建全部 limiter 并原子替换的配置更新方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: reloadConfig is the update method that rebuilds every limiter and atomically swaps them in.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is state tracked independently for each key.

optionExplanations: 全量重建连带清空每个 key 的历史，刚被限制的滥用者也会拿到一份全新配额。
误以为重建不能换实现类——Factory 正好能按新算法字段创建新对象。
误以为重建不能增加路由项——新 endpoint 完全可以随新 map 一起上线。
把 limiter 生命周期和结果对象混淆——Result 是请求返回值，不会因 limiter 重建而变空。
optionExplanations_en: Full rebuild wipes every key's history too, so a client just throttled gets a completely fresh quota again.
This wrongly assumes rebuild can't switch implementation class — the factory handles that from the new algorithm field.
This wrongly assumes rebuild can't add a route — a new endpoint ships fine alongside the new map.
This confuses limiter lifecycle with the result object — Result is a per-request value, unaffected by rebuild.
scenario: 线上发现某 client 在刷接口，运维把该 endpoint 限额从 100 调到 10 并触发 reload。
scenario_en: A client is hammering an endpoint in production, so ops lowers that endpoint limit from 100 to 10 and triggers a reload.

scenario: 需要在更新 capacity/refillRate 时保留 client 历史。
scenario_en: Client history must be preserved while updating capacity/refillRate.
q: 更复杂但保状态的方案是什么？
q_en: What is the more complex state-preserving approach?
options: 给 Limiter 加 updateConfig，各算法自己调参
误以为还是应该继续用重建全部 limiter 的老办法
误以为配置更新的解析逻辑该写进 RateLimitResult 里
误以为想保留状态就该先删光所有 bucket 再重建
options_en: Add updateConfig to Limiter so each algorithm adjusts its own parameters.
This mistakenly assumes the old rebuild-every-limiter approach is still the answer.
This mistakenly assumes update-parsing logic belongs inside RateLimitResult.
This mistakenly assumes preserving state means deleting every bucket first.
why: TokenBucket 可更新 capacity/refillRate，并把已有 tokens clamp 到新 capacity；不同算法需要各自不同的更新逻辑。
why_en: State-preserving dynamic config requires each limiter implementation to update its own parameters and existing state.
whenOtherWins: 如果算法类型本身也要改变（比如 TokenBucket 换 SlidingWindowLog），状态不兼容时仍可能需要替换 limiter。
tradeoff: 保留 per-key 历史 vs 每种算法都要写自己的更新逻辑

termDefinitions.meaning: 让每种算法自己调整参数、同时保留已有 per-key 状态的接口方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: updateConfig is the interface method letting each algorithm adjust its own parameters while keeping existing per-key state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数值限制在某个上限或下限之内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clamp restricts a value so it never exceeds a given upper or lower bound.

optionExplanations: 接口新增一个方法交给各实现自己处理——TokenBucket 降 capacity 时只需 clamp 已有 tokens，不丢历史。
又绕回会清空状态的简单方案——这正是要避免的、把滥用者重置成新用户的结果。
把配置更新的职责放错类——Result 是每次请求的返回值，不该持有配置逻辑。
把“保留状态”做反成了“清空状态”——删光 bucket 后下次请求会被当成全新 client。
optionExplanations_en: Adding updateConfig lets each algorithm handle its own parameters — TokenBucket just clamps existing tokens to the new capacity, no history lost.
This falls back to the state-wiping rebuild approach, exactly the abuser-resetting outcome we're trying to avoid.
This puts update-parsing duty on the wrong class — Result is a per-request return value, not a config holder.
This inverts 'preserve state' into 'wipe state' — deleting every bucket first makes the next request look brand new.

q: 按顺序排列 TokenBucket.updateConfig 的合理行为：
q_en: Put the reasonable TokenBucket.updateConfig behavior in order:
steps: 读取 newCapacity 和 newRefillRatePerSecond。
更新 limiter 参数。
遍历已有 buckets。
如果 bucket.tokens > newCapacity，则截断到 newCapacity。
why: 降低 capacity 时不能让旧 bucket 保留超过新容量的 token；参数更新和遍历 clamp 应放在同一临界区，避免请求线程看到半更新状态。
why_en: Token bucket config updates should adjust parameters and clamp existing buckets to the new capacity inside the same critical section so request threads never observe partial updates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时刻只允许一个线程执行的代码区域。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is a code region only one thread may execute at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数值限制在某个上限或下限之内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clamp restricts a value so it never exceeds a given upper or lower bound.

tradeoff: 保状态更新参数 vs 全量重建会清空 client 历史

scenario: 系统服务数百万 clientId，buckets/logs map 不断增长。
scenario_en: The service handles millions of clientIds, so the buckets/logs map keeps growing.
q: 需要什么机制？
q_en: What mechanism is needed?
options: 按 lastAccess 做 TTL 或 LRU 淘汰
误以为可以永远不清理任何 per-key 状态
误以为该用重启整个服务来释放内存
误以为把 clientId 写进日志级别能解决问题
options_en: Expire by lastAccess TTL, or evict with LRU.
This mistakenly assumes per-key state never needs cleanup.
This mistakenly assumes restarting the whole service frees memory.
This mistakenly assumes writing clientId into log level solves it.
why: on-demand 创建的 per-key state 如果不清理会内存泄漏；活跃 client 会持续更新 lastAccess，不活跃状态才会被淘汰。
why_en: Per-key limiter state needs TTL or LRU eviction to prevent unbounded memory growth from millions of clients.
whenOtherWins: 分布式 Redis 实现可以直接用 key TTL 自动过期，省去手写清理逻辑。
tradeoff: 主动淘汰控制内存 vs 无限增长直到 OOM
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["client bucket map grows"] --> B{"over capacity?"}
  B -- no --> C["keep bucket"]
  B -- yes --> D["evict old idle bucket"]
  D --> E["next request creates fresh bucket"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动删除长期不活跃的 per-key 状态以控制内存增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eviction actively removes long-idle per-key state to keep memory bounded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用淘汰策略，优先删除最久没被访问的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU evicts the entry that has gone the longest without being accessed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给缓存或状态条目设置的过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the expiration time set on a cached or tracked entry.

optionExplanations: 按 lastAccess 设 TTL 或用 LRU 淘汰，能让不活跃 client 的状态被回收，活跃的不受影响。
假设内存可以无限增长——数百万 clientId 会让 map 一路涨到 OOM。
把内存管理和服务可用性搞混——重启会丢失所有 client 状态，也不是长期方案。
把日志级别误当成状态清理机制——LogLevel 只影响输出，不会删除任何 per-key state。
optionExplanations_en: TTL by lastAccess or LRU eviction reclaims idle clients' state while leaving active ones untouched.
This assumes memory can grow forever — millions of clientIds would push the map straight to OOM.
This confuses memory management with availability — a restart loses every client's state and isn't a long-term fix.
This mistakes log level for a cleanup mechanism — it only affects output, never deletes per-key state.

q: 淘汰某 client 的 bucket 后，下次请求会怎样？
q_en: What happens on the next request after a client's bucket is evicted?
options: 像首次请求一样新建 state，拿到完整额度
误以为被淘汰的 client 之后会被永久拒绝
误以为淘汰 bucket 会连累 endpoint 路由失效
误以为新建 state 后 remaining 会变成负数
options_en: It creates fresh state like a first request, with full quota.
This mistakenly assumes the evicted client is denied forever afterward.
This mistakenly assumes evicting a bucket breaks endpoint routing too.
This mistakenly assumes remaining goes negative after fresh state is created.
why: 这对长期不活跃 client 通常可接受；活跃 client 不会被淘汰，因为它们的 lastAccess 会持续刷新。
why_en: After eviction, the next request creates fresh state, typically granting a new initial quota.
tradeoff: 淘汰后 fresh start（简单） vs 完全丢失该 client 的限流历史

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动删除长期不活跃的 per-key 状态以控制内存增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eviction actively removes long-idle per-key state to keep memory bounded.

optionExplanations: 淘汰只删旧状态，不删规则——下次请求重新建 bucket，通常从 full capacity 开始。
把一次清理误解为永久封禁——eviction 只是回收内存，不是拉黑。
把 per-key 状态和 endpoint 路由混为一谈——RateLimiter 的路由 map 不受淘汰影响。
误以为新对象会产生非法剩余额度——新建 state 的 remaining 从合法初始值算起。
optionExplanations_en: Eviction only removes old state, not the rule — the next request rebuilds a bucket, usually at full capacity.
This mistakes one cleanup pass for a permanent ban — eviction just reclaims memory, it's not a blacklist.
This confuses per-key state with endpoint routing — the routing map is untouched by eviction.
This wrongly assumes a fresh object yields an invalid remaining value — it's computed from a valid initial quota.
scenario: buckets map 用 30 分钟 TTL 清理，某个 client 沉默一小时后又发来请求。
scenario_en: The buckets map expires entries after a 30-minute TTL, and a client that went silent for an hour sends a request again.

q: 基础题明确 out of scope 的内容有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which items are explicitly out of scope for the basic problem? (Select all that apply.)
options: 分布式 Redis 限流
动态配置更新
指标和监控
复杂配置校验
每个请求都以 clientId 和 endpoint 作为输入
options_en: Distributed rate limiting with Redis.
Dynamic configuration updates.
Metrics and monitoring.
Deep configuration validation.
Every request carries clientId and endpoint as input.
why: 分布式、热更新、监控、深度校验都留给 follow-up；每个请求带 clientId 和 endpoint 则是基础输入要求。
why_en: These four items are explicitly out of scope, while clientId-plus-endpoint input is an in-scope base requirement, not something excluded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 唯一标识发起请求客户端的字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clientId is the string that uniquely identifies the caller making a request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被限流的 API 路径标识，用作查配置的 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: endpoint is the API path used as the lookup key for its rate-limit config.

optionExplanations: 跨实例共享限流状态的分布式方案明确排除在基础版本外。
运行时热更新配置也排在 out of scope——基础版本配置只在启动时加载一次。
限流命中率、拒绝率这类指标监控同样不在这版要求里。
配置字段的复杂合法性校验也被排除，基础版本假设配置是可信的。
这其实是 in-scope 的基础输入要求，不是被排除的部分——clientId+endpoint 正是请求必须携带的两个字段。
optionExplanations_en: Sharing limiter state across instances via a distributed backend is explicitly excluded from the base design.
Runtime config hot-reload is also out of scope — the base design only loads config once at startup.
Metrics like hit rate or deny rate are likewise not part of this version's requirements.
Deep validation of config fields is excluded too — the base design trusts the config as given.
This is actually an in-scope base requirement, not something excluded — clientId and endpoint are exactly what every request must carry.
scenario: 面试官限定：单个 JVM 进程内跑通即可，配置来自可信的启动文件，可观测性先不谈。
scenario_en: The interviewer scopes it to one JVM process, config comes from a trusted startup file, and observability is deferred.

scenario: 要新增 FixedWindowCounterLimiter。
scenario_en: You need to add FixedWindowCounterLimiter.
q: 需要改哪些地方？
q_en: What needs to change?
options: 实现 Limiter 接口，Factory 加一个 case
误以为要重写 RateLimiter.allow 这个入口方法
误以为要改动 RateLimitResult 的字段结构
误以为加新算法要先删掉已有的 TokenBucket
options_en: Implement the Limiter interface and add one case to the factory.
This mistakenly assumes RateLimiter.allow, the entry point, must be rewritten.
This mistakenly assumes RateLimitResult's fields must change.
This mistakenly assumes adding an algorithm requires deleting TokenBucket first.
why: 这就是 Strategy + Factory 的价值：RateLimiter 只依赖 Limiter 接口，不关心具体算法，新增互不影响已有代码。
why_en: Adding an algorithm means implementing Limiter and teaching the factory to construct it, without touching existing code.
whenOtherWins: 算法插件很多时，factory 里的 switch 可换成 registry，减少每次新增对核心 factory 的修改。
tradeoff: 开闭原则：只加代码不改现有类 vs 每加一个算法都要碰核心类

termDefinitions.meaning: 把可互换的算法封装成同一接口的不同实现的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms behind one common interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把'根据类型创建哪个具体实现'集中到一个类里的创建型模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The factory pattern centralizes the logic for creating the right concrete implementation from input data.

optionExplanations: 只加一个新实现和一个 Factory case，RateLimiter 和已有算法完全不用碰——这就是 Strategy+Factory 的价值。
把改动范围错误地扩大到入口方法——allow 只做路由委派，不关心具体算法。
把改动范围错误地扩大到结果对象——Result 的字段是通用的，不因算法而变。
把新增和删除混为一谈——TokenBucket 仍在正常工作，不需要移除。
optionExplanations_en: Just add one implementation and one factory case — RateLimiter and existing algorithms stay untouched, exactly what Strategy plus Factory buys you.
This wrongly widens the change to the entry point — allow only routes and delegates, it doesn't know about algorithms.
This wrongly widens the change to the result object — Result's fields are generic and algorithm-independent.
This conflates adding a new algorithm with removing an old one — TokenBucket keeps working fine.

q: remaining 字段表示什么？
q_en: What does the remaining field mean?
options: 当前请求处理之后剩余的可用额度
误以为是请求处理之前的额度
误以为是总配置上限
误以为是 retryAfterMs 的秒数
options_en: The quota still available after the current request is processed.
This mistakenly assumes it is the quota before the request.
This mistakenly assumes it is the configured total limit.
This mistakenly assumes it is retryAfterMs expressed in seconds.
why: 先扣掉本次消耗再报余量，调用方看到的是接下来还能发几次，而不是配置里的静态上限。
why_en: Remaining represents quota left after processing the current request, not the quota before it or the configured limit.
tradeoff: remaining 反映处理后的状态 vs 若返回处理前的值会多报 1

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理完当前请求后，调用方还剩多少可用额度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: remaining is how much quota the caller has left after this request is processed.

optionExplanations: 允许后先扣 1 再 floor(tokens) 返回，remaining 描述的是这次请求之后还能做多少次。
把返回时点放到了扣减之前——按处理前的值返回会比真实剩余多报 1。
把动态剩余额度当成静态配置——总上限不会反映这个 client 已经用掉多少。
把两个不同的结果字段混在一起——等待时间有自己独立的 retryAfterMs 字段。
optionExplanations_en: After deducting one token, remaining reports floor(tokens) — how many more calls this client can make right now.
This measures before deduction — reporting the pre-request value overstates remaining by one.
This treats a dynamic remaining quota as a static config value, ignoring what this client already spent.
This mixes up two separate fields — wait time has its own retryAfterMs field.

scenario: 请求 endpoint='/unknown'，配置里没有该 endpoint。
scenario_en: A request comes in for endpoint='/unknown', and that endpoint is missing from config.
q: 基础设计如何处理？
q_en: How should the base design handle this?
options: 调用 defaultLimiter.allow 走默认限流
误以为未知 endpoint 应该无条件放行所有请求
误以为未知 endpoint 应该直接拒绝所有传入请求
误以为应该临时创建一个无上限的 limiter
options_en: Call defaultLimiter.allow to apply the default rate limit.
This mistakenly assumes unknown endpoints should be allowed unconditionally.
This mistakenly assumes unknown endpoints should be denied outright for every incoming request.
This mistakenly assumes an unlimited limiter should be created on the fly.
why: 需求明确未配置 endpoint 要使用默认限制，确保所有请求至少有基础保护，而不是被放行或直接拒绝。
why_en: Unknown endpoints fall back to the default limiter instead of bypassing rate limiting or being denied outright.
whenOtherWins: 如果希望未知 endpoint 独立计数，可用 defaultConfig 懒创建各自的 endpoint-specific limiter。

termDefinitions.meaning: 未配置 endpoint 时使用的兜底 Limiter 实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: defaultLimiter is the fallback Limiter instance used when an endpoint has no specific config.

optionExplanations: 统一走 default 兜底，任何没配置 endpoint 的请求也至少有一层保护。
把“没有专门配置”误解为“不需要限流”——这会给攻击者一个绕过限流的漏洞。
把还没配置的 endpoint 误判成“应该拒绝”——会误伤所有正常的新 endpoint。
误以为没配置就该无限放行——无上限等于没有限流，风险跟不设限一样。
optionExplanations_en: Falling back to defaultLimiter.allow(clientId) means even an unconfigured endpoint still gets baseline protection.
This misreads 'no specific config' as 'no limiting needed,' handing attackers a way to bypass limiting entirely.
This misjudges an unconfigured endpoint as one that 'should be denied,' wrongly blocking legitimate new endpoints.
This wrongly assumes missing config means unlimited — no cap is functionally the same as no rate limiting.

q: 按顺序排列 TokenBucket 的验证例子：
q_en: Put the TokenBucket verification example in order:
steps: t=0 首次请求创建 tokens=10 的 bucket。
允许请求后 tokens=9，remaining=9。
t=500ms，按 1 token/s 补 0.5，tokens=9.5。
再允许后 tokens=8.5，remaining=floor(8.5)=8。
桶空附近请求被拒绝，并返回补足 1 token 的 retryAfterMs。
why: 验证覆盖首次创建、连续补充、小数 token、扣减和拒绝重试计算，逐步复现真实运行时序。
why_en: The token bucket trace validates first-use capacity, fractional refill, consumption, remaining, and retry timing in order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 key 一个令牌桶，按固定速率补充令牌，允许短时突发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Token bucket gives each key a bucket that refills at a fixed rate and allows short bursts up to its capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 令牌桶能容纳的最大令牌数，即最大突发量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: capacity is the maximum number of tokens a bucket can hold, i.e. the largest burst it allows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理完当前请求后，调用方还剩多少可用额度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: remaining is how much quota the caller has left after this request is processed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求被拒绝时，建议客户端等待多少毫秒后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: retryAfterMs tells a denied caller how many milliseconds to wait before retrying.

tradeoff: 用时序例子验证边界 vs 只看静态字段定义容易漏掉扣减时点

q: Senior 级 Rate Limiter 回答应主动覆盖哪些点？（多选）
q_en: What should a senior Rate Limiter answer proactively cover? (Select all that apply.)
options: Factory/Strategy 的边界
on-demand refill vs background refill
per-key locking 而非全局锁
动态配置重建 vs 保状态更新
per-key state eviction
必须提前实现分布式 Redis 限流才算 senior
options_en: The boundary between Factory and Strategy.
On-demand refill versus background refill.
Per-key locking rather than a global lock.
Rebuild-on-reload versus state-preserving config updates.
Per-key state eviction.
You must implement distributed Redis rate limiting to count as senior.
why: 高级答案要覆盖对象边界、补充模型、并发粒度、配置演进和内存上界；跨实例共享状态属于后续扩展。
why_en: A senior answer covers boundaries, refill, per-key concurrency, config evolution, and eviction without requiring distributed Redis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只对同一个 key 的并发请求加锁，不同 key 互不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key locking only serializes concurrent requests for the same key, so different keys never block each other.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动删除长期不活跃的 per-key 状态以控制内存增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eviction actively removes long-idle per-key state to keep memory bounded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在请求到来时按经过时间计算补充量，不用后台线程扫描。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: On-demand refill computes the refill amount from elapsed time only when a request arrives, with no background scanning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存数据存储，可用来做分布式共享限流状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory data store often used to share rate-limit state across processes.

optionExplanations: 说清 Factory 只管创建、Strategy(Limiter)只管算法，两者边界不混。
解释按需补充为什么够用，不用后台线程扫描所有 bucket。
讲清并发正确性靠的是 per-key 锁，不是把所有请求串成一条队。
对比重建全量替换（简单但清状态）和保状态 updateConfig（复杂但保历史）。
说明长期运行下 per-key 状态需要 TTL/LRU，内存不会无限涨。
把本题从单机 LLD 硬拔高成分布式系统实现——分布式 Redis 是扩展话题，不是这道题的门槛。
optionExplanations_en: Explain that the factory only creates while Strategy (Limiter) only runs the algorithm — the boundary stays clean.
Explain why on-demand refill is enough, with no background thread scanning every bucket.
Explain that concurrency correctness comes from per-key locks, not serializing every request behind one lock.
Contrast rebuild-and-swap (simple but wipes state) against state-preserving updateConfig (more work, keeps history).
Explain that per-key state needs TTL or LRU over time, or memory grows without bound.
This inflates a single-node LLD into distributed infrastructure — Redis is the extension topic, not this problem's bar.
scenario: 45 分钟单机 LLD 面试，面试官不再追问基础类图，开始问长期运行下会出什么问题。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute single-node LLD interview, the interviewer stops probing the base class diagram and asks what breaks over long uptime.

q: 按顺序排列 Rate Limiter 主设计链路：
q_en: Put the main Rate Limiter design chain in order:
steps: RateLimiter 持有 endpoint->Limiter 和 defaultLimiter。
澄清启动配置、clientId/endpoint 输入、结构化结果和默认限制。
Limiter interface 让不同算法成为策略。
LimiterFactory 从 algorithm/algoConfig 创建具体 limiter。
具体 limiter 管理自己的 per-key state，并处理线程安全和内存清理扩展。
why: 这个链路从范围和入口到策略、工厂和算法状态，说明 RateLimiter 不应管理所有算法内部字段。
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to routing state, the strategy interface, factory creation, and algorithm-owned per-key state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统入口/编排类，负责按 endpoint 路由到具体 Limiter。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RateLimiter is the entry-point class that routes each request to the right Limiter implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据配置中的 algorithm 字段创建具体 Limiter 实例的工厂类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LimiterFactory reads the algorithm field in config and instantiates the matching Limiter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 未配置 endpoint 时使用的兜底 Limiter 实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: defaultLimiter is the fallback Limiter instance used when an endpoint has no specific config.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is state tracked independently for each key.

tradeoff: 编排层保持薄 vs 把算法状态塞进 RateLimiter

scenario: 系统改成多线程环境，多个请求可能同时命中同一个 clientId。
scenario_en: The system now runs multi-threaded, so multiple requests may hit the same clientId at once.
q: 哪条不变量最能保证限流仍然正确？
q_en: Which invariant best keeps rate limiting correct?
options: 同一 key 的 state 更新必须原子化
误以为所有 endpoint 必须共用同一种算法
误以为 retryAfterMs 永远只能是 null
误以为每个请求都必须新建一个 limiter
options_en: Updates to one key’s state must be atomic.
This mistakenly assumes every endpoint must share one algorithm.
This mistakenly assumes retryAfterMs can only ever be null.
This mistakenly assumes a limiter must be created fresh per request.
why: 限流正确性取决于 per-key 状态的一致更新，无论算法是 bucket 还是 sliding log，同一 key 的检查+写入都必须原子。
why_en: The core invariant is atomic per-key state update so concurrent requests cannot spend the same quota twice.
whenOtherWins: 单线程同步调用中不需要锁，但一旦多线程或异步交错，就需要同步或事务保护。
tradeoff: per-key 原子更新的正确性 vs 加锁带来的并发开销

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 key 独立维护的状态数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is state tracked independently for each key.

optionExplanations: 拿锁的边界要卡在 per-key 状态本身——检查剩余额度和真正扣减必须发生在同一个原子操作里，才不会被并发请求撞车。
把算法选择自由度误当成必须统一——不同 endpoint 本可以各配各的算法，互不影响。
忽略了拒绝路径会返回真实等待时间——retryAfterMs 只有放行时才是 null。
把一次性创建误当成每请求都要重建——重建会丢失该 client 已积累的限流状态。
optionExplanations_en: The lock must wrap the per-key state itself — checking remaining quota and deducting it need to happen as one atomic step, or concurrent requests collide.
This wrongly turns algorithm freedom into forced uniformity — different endpoints can use different algorithms independently.
This ignores that the deny path returns a real wait — retryAfterMs is null only when the request is allowed.
This confuses one-time creation with per-request rebuilding — rebuilding would discard that client's accumulated state.

q: 中级候选人在本题最应稳定说明什么？
q_en: What should a mid-level candidate explain reliably in this problem?
options: 说清编排、创建、状态管理各归哪个类
误以为面试必须背下所有限流算法的名字
误以为中级候选人必须现场写出分布式 Redis 脚本
误以为应该强行把 Client 建成一个实体类
options_en: Explain which class owns orchestration, creation, and state.
This mistakenly assumes you must memorize every algorithm's name for the interview.
This mistakenly assumes mid-level candidates must write a distributed Redis script live.
This mistakenly assumes Client should be forced into its own entity class.
why: 中级答案要能划清 RateLimiter、Factory、Limiter、Result 的对象边界和状态归属；死背算法名或提前写分布式 Redis 都偏离主线。
why_en: A mid-level answer should separate orchestration, creation, limiter state, and result semantics, not jump to Redis or trivia.
tradeoff: 划清类边界和状态归属 vs 死记算法名称或提前实现分布式方案

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据配置中的 algorithm 字段创建具体 Limiter 实例的工厂类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LimiterFactory reads the algorithm field in config and instantiates the matching Limiter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存数据存储，可用来做分布式共享限流状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory data store often used to share rate-limit state across processes.

optionExplanations: 划清 RateLimiter 编排、Factory 创建、Limiter 管理状态这几个对象边界，面试官就能看到清晰的委派路径。
把目标误判成算法名词背诵——算法名只有在解释具体取舍时才有用。
把单机对象设计升级成分布式脚本题——Redis 脚本是扩展话题，不是基础答案核心。
把无行为输入硬建成实体——Client 只有在聚合套餐、身份和状态时才值得建类。
optionExplanations_en: Separating RateLimiter's orchestration, the factory's creation, and each Limiter's state gives the interviewer a clear delegation path.
This mistakes the goal for reciting algorithm names — names only matter when explaining a concrete tradeoff.
This turns a single-node object design into a distributed scripting task — Redis scripts belong to the extension, not the base answer.
This forces a behavior-free input into an entity — Client only deserves one when it owns plan, identity, or state.
scenario: 中级候选人在 45 分钟单机限流器 LLD 里，只需要把一套能跑的对象设计讲清楚。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute single-node rate limiter LLD, a mid-level candidate only needs to explain a workable object design clearly.

scenario: 需求只说了「按 endpoint 配置限流、收到请求返回 allowed/remaining/retryAfterMs」，没提过查询或修改配置。
scenario_en: Requirements only say: configure limits per endpoint and return allowed/remaining/retryAfterMs per request. Nothing about reading or changing config.
q: RateLimiter 该不该顺手加上 getConfig / updateConfig？
q_en: Should RateLimiter also expose getConfig / updateConfig?
options: 不加，只保留 allow(clientId, endpoint)
加 getConfig，方便以后排查线上问题时把当前生效配置读出来核对
加 updateConfig，这样配置服务推新值时不用重启进程
两个都加，接口写全一点显得考虑周到、也不占运行时开销
options_en: No — keep only allow(clientId, endpoint).
Add getConfig so the currently effective config can be read back when debugging production.
Add updateConfig so the config service can push new values without a restart.
Add both — a fuller interface looks thorough and costs nothing at runtime.
why: 需求没要求查询/更新配置，多出来的方法就是无人调用的表面积，违反 YAGNI。代价是真需要热更新时得回头补 reloadConfig，但那时需求已经明确、能一次设计对。
why_en: Nothing in the requirements asks to read or mutate config, so those methods are unused surface area — that is exactly what YAGNI warns against.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明确提出「配置服务会在运行中推送新规则」，热更新就进了需求，这时才该设计 reloadConfig 或 updateConfig。
tradeoff: 接口最小化（少维护、少测试）vs 提前预留扩展点（改需求时少改代码）

termDefinitions.meaning: You Aren't Gonna Need It：需求没提出来的功能就先不写。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI stands for You Aren't Gonna Need It: don't build what the requirements never asked for.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重新读取配置并整体重建全部 limiter 实例的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: reloadConfig is a method that re-reads config and rebuilds every limiter instance.

optionExplanations: 公开接口只有 allow 一个入口，配置在构造函数一次性吃进去，读写路径就没有第二条。
调试可以靠日志打印构造时的 config，不必为此在生产接口上永久开一个读口。
热更新是一条独立的需求线，没被提出来时先不做；真要做，reloadConfig 整体替换比零散 setter 更好推理。
「写全一点」是典型的 YAGNI 陷阱——每个方法都要测试、要保持语义，改设计时全是包袱。
optionExplanations_en: allow is the only entry point; config is consumed once in the constructor, so there is no second read/write path.
Debugging can log the config at construction time instead of leaving a permanent read hole in the production interface.
Hot reload is a separate requirement thread — if it does surface, a whole-map reloadConfig reasons better than scattered setters.
Filling out the interface "to be thorough" is the classic YAGNI trap: every method needs tests and semantics forever.

scenario: 配置服务推来一条 endpoint 配置，algorithm 字段写成了 "TokenBuckett"（拼错）。LimiterFactory 的 switch 没有匹配到任何 case。
scenario_en: The config service pushes an endpoint config whose algorithm field reads "TokenBuckett" (a typo). The LimiterFactory switch matches no case.
q: 如果 default 分支不抛异常而是静默返回默认 limiter，会发生什么？
q_en: What happens if the default branch silently returns a default limiter instead of throwing?
options: 进程照常启动，该 endpoint 长期跑在错误配额上且无人察觉
进程照常启动，但第一次请求到达时会抛出 IllegalArgumentException
进程启动失败，配置服务收到明确的 Unknown algorithm 报错
该 endpoint 的所有请求都会被拒绝，客户端立刻收到 429 并暴露问题
options_en: The process starts fine and that endpoint quietly runs on the wrong quota indefinitely.
The process starts fine, but the first incoming request throws IllegalArgumentException.
Startup fails and the config service gets an explicit Unknown algorithm error.
Every request to that endpoint is rejected, so clients see 429s and the problem surfaces at once.
why: 静默降级把配置错误变成没有症状的坏状态：limiter 建出来了、请求照常放行，只是限流值不是你配的那个。fail fast 抛异常的代价是启动更脆，但错误在离原因最近处暴露。
why_en: Silently falling back turns a config typo into a symptomless wrong state — the endpoint runs on a quota nobody chose until traffic breaks it, so the factory should fail fast instead.
tradeoff: fail fast（启动即崩，错误定位快）vs 静默降级（可用性不受影响，但错误无声）

termDefinitions.meaning: 一发现非法输入就立刻报错，不带着坏状态继续跑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fail fast means raising an error the moment invalid input is seen, rather than continuing with bad state.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 中表示传入参数非法的标准运行时异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IllegalArgumentException is the standard Java runtime exception for an invalid argument.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 状态码 Too Many Requests，限流拒绝时返回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 429 means Too Many Requests, the status returned when a rate limiter denies a request.

optionExplanations: limiter 被正常构造进 map，allow 也一路返回 allowed=true，错误既不抛也不打日志，只能靠事后对账发现。
构造是在 RateLimiter 构造函数里一次性做完的，静默分支已经给出对象，请求路径上不会再有异常。
这正是 fail fast 的结果——但前提是 default 分支真的 throw，静默降级恰恰放弃了它。
默认 limiter 有自己的正常配额，不会全拒；「全拒」反而是一种更容易被发现的失败。
optionExplanations_en: The limiter lands in the map normally and allow keeps returning allowed=true — no throw, no log, only a later audit reveals it.
Construction happens once inside the RateLimiter constructor; the silent branch already returned an object, so the request path stays clean.
That is exactly what fail fast buys — but only if the default branch actually throws, which silent fallback gives up.
The default limiter has its own normal quota, so it will not deny everything; total denial would actually be easier to notice.

scenario: 面试里的 LimiterFactory 只需要支持 TokenBucket 和 SlidingWindowLog 两种算法，算法集合在启动时就固定。
scenario_en: In the interview scope, LimiterFactory needs only TokenBucket and SlidingWindowLog, and the algorithm set is fixed at startup.
q: 此时 switch 分派和 registry 模式该选哪个？
q_en: Switch dispatch or a registry pattern here?
options: 用 switch 分派，两个算法时它更直接
用 registry，把 Map<String, Constructor> 在启动时注册好
用 registry，因为 switch 在任何规模下都算硬编码坏味道
两个都不用，让每个 endpoint 自己 new 出对应的 limiter 实现类
options_en: Use switch dispatch — with two algorithms it is more direct.
Use a registry: register a Map<String, Constructor> at startup.
Use a registry, since a switch is a hardcoding smell at any scale.
Use neither — let each endpoint new up its own limiter implementation.
why: 算法集合固定且只有两个时，switch 把「哪个字符串对应哪个构造」摊在一屏里读完，而 registry 要多一层注册表和注册时机。代价是 switch 会随算法数量线性变长，加第三、第四个算法时就该换 registry。
why_en: With two fixed algorithms a switch shows the whole mapping on one screen, while a registry adds a table plus registration timing you must reason about.
whenOtherWins: 当算法需要运行时可插拔——例如插件或不同部署各带各的算法集合——registry 让新算法只注册不改工厂代码。
tradeoff: switch 的直读性 vs registry 的运行时可插拔性

termDefinitions.meaning: 注册表模式：用一张 name→构造器的映射表替代硬编码分支，启动时把实现注册进去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The registry pattern replaces hardcoded branches with a name-to-constructor map that implementations register into at startup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按一个判别字段（这里是 algorithm）走 switch 分支决定创建哪个类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Switch dispatch picks which class to instantiate by switching on a discriminator field such as algorithm.

optionExplanations: 判别字段 algorithm 只有两个取值，分支表就是完整的真相来源，读代码的人不必再去找谁注册了什么。
registry 在算法要运行时插拔时才回本；此处注册表和注册调用都是纯增的间接层。
「switch 一律是坏味道」是把重构规则当教条——分支数量少且封闭时它恰恰是最易读的形态。
散落的 new 正是工厂要消灭的东西：创建逻辑会复制到每个用到 limiter 的地方，改一处漏一处。
optionExplanations_en: The algorithm discriminator has two values, so the branch table is the whole truth — no hunting for who registered what.
A registry pays off only when algorithms must be pluggable at runtime; here the map and its registration calls are pure indirection.
Treating "switch is always a smell" as dogma ignores that a small closed branch set is the most readable form.
Scattered new calls are what a factory exists to remove — creation logic gets copied to every call site and drifts.

scenario: Token Bucket 按需补充：每次请求算 elapsed = now - lastRefillTime，tokensToAdd = elapsed × refillRatePerSecond ÷ 1000。某 client 三天没发请求了。
scenario_en: Token Bucket refills on demand: each request computes elapsed = now - lastRefillTime and tokensToAdd = elapsed × refillRatePerSecond ÷ 1000. One client has been idle for three days.
q: tokensToAdd 会算出巨大值，靠什么兜住？
q_en: tokensToAdd comes out enormous — what keeps it bounded?
options: tokens = min(capacity, tokens + tokensToAdd)
补充前先判断 elapsed 是否超过阈值，超过就把整个 bucket 重置成满桶状态
后台线程定期把每个 bucket 的 tokens 压回 capacity 以内
把 tokens 字段声明为 double，浮点数足够大所以不会出问题
options_en: tokens = min(capacity, tokens + tokensToAdd).
Check whether elapsed exceeds a threshold before refilling, and reset the whole bucket to full if it does.
Have a background thread periodically clamp every bucket back down to capacity.
Declare tokens as a double — floating point is big enough that nothing breaks.
why: 三天空闲会算出几十万 token，但 min(capacity, …) 让补充结果永远封顶在桶容量，长时间空闲和刚好补满在语义上等价。代价是空闲期积累的额度全部作废，client 拿不到「攒了三天」的超额突发。
why_en: Three idle days would add hundreds of thousands of tokens, but clamping with min(capacity, ...) caps the refill at bucket capacity, so a long idle client is treated exactly like a freshly full one.
tradeoff: 封顶带来的突发上限可控 vs 空闲客户端积累的额度被丢弃

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次请求时间与该 bucket 上次补充时间之差（毫秒）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Elapsed is the milliseconds between now and the last time this bucket was refilled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 桶容量：单个 client 能积累的 token 上限，也就是最大突发量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Capacity is the maximum tokens one client can hold, which is also the largest burst allowed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 突发：短时间内一次性打出的请求量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A burst is a large number of requests fired in a very short span.

optionExplanations: 封顶动作和正常补充是同一行代码，不需要为「空闲很久」单开一条路径，边界情况自然消失。
阈值判断是多余的特判：min 已经把任何大小的 elapsed 压到同一个结果，再加阈值只是引入一个要调的魔数。
后台线程要遍历全部 bucket，绝大多数是空闲 client，正是按需补充要避开的浪费。
double 确实不会溢出，但不溢出不等于正确——不封顶的话该 client 一次能打出远超 capacity 的突发。
optionExplanations_en: The clamp lives in the same line as the normal refill, so no separate "long idle" path is needed and the edge case disappears.
A threshold check is a redundant special case: min already collapses any elapsed to the same result, and it adds a magic number to tune.
A background thread must walk every bucket, mostly idle clients — precisely the waste on-demand refill avoids.
A double will not overflow, but not overflowing is not correctness: without the clamp that client could burst far past capacity.

scenario: 你选了保状态方案：Limiter 接口加 updateConfig，改限流值时不重建 limiter。现在配置把 /search 从 TokenBucket 改成 SlidingWindowLog。
scenario_en: You chose the state-preserving path: Limiter gained updateConfig so changing limits does not rebuild the limiter. Now config switches /search from TokenBucket to SlidingWindowLog.
q: 这次变更为什么不能走 updateConfig？
q_en: Why can this particular change not go through updateConfig?
options: 两种算法的 per-key 状态形状不兼容，必须换掉 limiter 实例
updateConfig 只能改数值参数，改不了 algorithm 这个字符串字段
SlidingWindowLog 不实现 updateConfig，调用会抛 UnsupportedOperationException
算法切换必须先停止接收请求，updateConfig 没有提供这个暂停语义
options_en: The two algorithms hold incompatible per-key state, so the limiter instance must be replaced.
updateConfig can only change numeric parameters, not the algorithm string field.
SlidingWindowLog does not implement updateConfig, so the call throws UnsupportedOperationException.
Switching algorithms requires pausing intake, and updateConfig offers no such pause.
why: TokenBucket 存 (tokens, lastRefillTime)，SlidingWindowLog 存 timestamp 列表，没有把前者翻译成后者的规则，只能造新实例替换。代价是这条路径上 per-key 状态确实会丢。
why_en: Token Bucket keeps (tokens, lastRefillTime) while Sliding Window Log keeps a list of timestamps — there is no sane translation, so the limiter must be replaced and its per-key state lost.
tradeoff: 保状态更新的连续性 vs 算法切换必须整体替换实例

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个 client key 单独维护的限流状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-key state is the rate limiting state tracked separately for each client key.

termDefinitions.meaning: Limiter 接口上的方法：就地改参数并保留已有 per-key 状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: updateConfig is a Limiter method that changes parameters in place while keeping existing per-key state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 滑动窗口日志算法：为每个 key 保存请求时间戳列表，按窗口内条数判定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sliding Window Log stores a list of request timestamps per key and decides by counting those inside the window.

optionExplanations: 状态形状不同意味着没有迁移函数：30 个剩余 token 换算不出「过去一分钟发了几次」，只能重建。
真正的障碍不是字段类型，而是新算法需要一份根本不存在的历史数据。
接口一旦加了 updateConfig，两个实现都会实现它——问题出在跨实现迁移，不是缺方法。
暂停接收请求是并发同步问题，和这里「状态无法翻译」是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Different state shapes mean no migration function exists: 30 remaining tokens cannot become "how many calls in the last minute".
The real blocker is not a field type but that the new algorithm needs history that was never recorded.
Once updateConfig is on the interface both implementations have it — the problem is cross-implementation migration, not a missing method.
Pausing intake is a concurrency-synchronization concern, separate from state being untranslatable.

scenario: Senior 面试里，面试官追问 Token Bucket 里 now、lastRefillTime、elapsed 这些毫秒时间戳算术的整数溢出风险。
scenario_en: In a senior interview, the interviewer probes integer overflow risk in the millisecond timestamp arithmetic (now, lastRefillTime, elapsed) inside Token Bucket.
q: 这些毫秒时间戳字段应该用什么类型承载？
q_en: What type should those millisecond timestamp fields use?
options: long（64 位整数）存毫秒时间戳
int（32 位整数）存毫秒时间戳，省一半内存且缓存更友好
double 存毫秒时间戳，和 tokens 字段保持类型一致
不存绝对时间戳，每次请求都从 0 开始重新计时
options_en: A long (64-bit integer) holding milliseconds.
An int (32-bit integer) holding milliseconds — half the memory and more cache friendly.
A double holding milliseconds, matching the type of the tokens field.
Store no absolute timestamp; restart the clock from 0 on every request.
why: 毫秒纪元时间戳早已超出 32 位整数范围，用 int 会溢出成负数，让 elapsed 算出负值、tokensToAdd 变负，桶反而被扣空。代价只是每个 bucket 多几个字节。
why_en: Millisecond epoch timestamps long ago outgrew 32-bit range, so an int wraps negative and elapsed goes negative, which silently drains buckets instead of refilling them.
whenOtherWins: 如果只存「相对某个启动基准的偏移」且进程生命周期有限，窄类型才够用——但那要额外维护基准，不如直接用 long。
tradeoff: 64 位时间戳的安全边界 vs 每个 bucket 多占的几字节内存

termDefinitions.meaning: 整数溢出：数值超出该类型能表示的范围，回绕成错误的（常为负）值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Integer overflow happens when a value exceeds the type range and wraps around to a wrong, often negative, number.

termDefinitions.meaning: 纪元时间戳：从 1970-01-01 起算的时间数值，这里以毫秒计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An epoch timestamp counts time from 1970-01-01, here measured in milliseconds.

termDefinitions.meaning: bucket 上一次补充 token 的时刻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: lastRefillTime is when the bucket last had tokens added.

optionExplanations: 64 位足以容纳毫秒纪元时间戳，elapsed 的减法在任何空闲时长下都保持正值。
省下的几字节换来的是回绕后的负 elapsed，补充量变负，client 会被莫名扣光额度。
double 不会回绕但会在大数值上丢精度，时间戳相减的毫秒级差值可能被舍掉。
不存绝对时间就没法算「距上次补充过了多久」，按需补充的整个前提就没了。
optionExplanations_en: 64 bits comfortably hold a millisecond epoch value, so the elapsed subtraction stays positive at any idle length.
The few saved bytes buy a wrapped negative elapsed, a negative refill, and clients mysteriously drained to zero.
A double will not wrap but loses precision at large magnitudes, so millisecond differences can be rounded away.
Without an absolute timestamp there is no "how long since the last refill", which is the whole premise of on-demand refill.

scenario: 产品陆续要求支持 FixedWindowCounter、SlidingWindowCounter、LeakyBucket 等算法，全部经由 LimiterFactory 的 switch 创建。
scenario_en: The product keeps adding algorithms — FixedWindowCounter, SlidingWindowCounter, LeakyBucket — all created through the LimiterFactory switch.
q: Factory 集中创建带来的代价具体表现在哪？
q_en: Where does the cost of centralizing creation in the factory show up?
options: switch 会随算法数量线性膨胀，每加一个算法都要改这一个文件
每次 create 调用都要顺序比较所有 case，请求路径延迟随算法数上升
所有算法被迫共用同一份 algoConfig 参数集合，无法各带各的参数
Factory 变成单点故障：某个算法构造失败会让其它 endpoint 的 limiter 一起失效
options_en: The switch grows linearly with the algorithm count — every new algorithm edits this one file.
Each create call compares all cases in order, so request-path latency rises with the algorithm count.
All algorithms are forced onto one shared algoConfig parameter set and cannot carry their own.
The factory becomes a single point of failure: one algorithm failing to construct kills the other endpoints' limiters.
why: Factory 把散落的 new 收进一处，换来的是这一处会随算法数量不断变长、成为每次新增算法的必经改动点。这正是 registry 模式接手的信号。
why_en: The factory trades scattered new calls for one file that keeps growing, and that file becomes the mandatory edit point for every new algorithm.
tradeoff: 创建逻辑集中（改一处、不漏）vs 该处随算法数量膨胀（每次新增都要动它）

termDefinitions.meaning: 配置里嵌套的算法专属参数对象，不同算法字段不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: algoConfig is the nested object of algorithm-specific parameters, whose fields differ per algorithm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 漏桶算法：请求以固定速率流出，超出则被拒。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Leaky Bucket drains requests at a fixed rate and rejects anything beyond it.

optionExplanations: 每个新算法 = 一个新 case + 一段参数提取，文件长度和算法数一一对应地涨。
create 只在启动构造时跑一次，请求路径走的是 map 查找，不经过 switch。
algoConfig 是异构的——不同算法本来就各取各的字段，工厂负责的正是这层解析。
构造失败在启动期就抛出来了，是 fail fast 的设计意图，不是运行时的连锁失效。
optionExplanations_en: Each new algorithm means one more case plus its parameter extraction, so file length tracks algorithm count one for one.
create runs once at construction; the request path is a map lookup and never touches the switch.
algoConfig is heterogeneous by design — each algorithm reads its own fields, and parsing that is the factory's job.
A construction failure throws at startup by design (fail fast); it is not a runtime cascade.

scenario: RateLimitResult 打包一次限流决定：allowed、remaining、retryAfterMs。它会从 limiter 返回给 RateLimiter，再返回给调用方，多线程环境下还会被并发读。
scenario_en: RateLimitResult packages one decision: allowed, remaining, retryAfterMs. It flows from the limiter to RateLimiter to the caller, and is read concurrently in a multi-threaded setup.
q: 把它设计成创建后不可变，买到的是什么？
q_en: What does making it immutable after creation buy you?
options: 它只是那一刻决定的快照，传出去后不会被任何人改写
它可以被缓存复用，同一个 client 后续请求直接返回同一个对象
它能随桶的 token 变化自动刷新 remaining，读到的永远是最新值
它省掉了 setter 方法，因此 JSON 序列化时字段更少、响应体更小
options_en: It is a snapshot of that one decision and nobody can rewrite it after it is handed out.
It can be cached and reused, returning the same object for that client's later requests.
Its remaining auto-refreshes as bucket tokens change, so readers always see the latest value.
It drops setters, so JSON serialization emits fewer fields and a smaller response body.
why: 决定是在锁内算出来的，一旦对象离开那个临界区就不该再变；不可变让它可以自由跨线程传递而无需再同步。代价是每次请求都要新建一个对象，但这是短命的小对象。
why_en: The decision is computed inside the lock, and immutability means the object can be passed across threads afterwards without any further synchronization.
whenOtherWins: 如果返回的是一个需要下游继续补字段的可变上下文对象（比如逐层附加 trace 信息），可变才更方便。
tradeoff: 不可变带来的线程安全与可预测性 vs 每次请求多分配一个对象

termDefinitions.meaning: 值对象：只承载数据、按值比较、创建后不改的对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A value object carries data, compares by value, and does not change after creation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不可变：对象构造完成后所有字段都不再被修改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Immutable means no field of the object is modified after construction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被拒时告诉客户端还要等多少毫秒才能重试；放行时为 null。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: retryAfterMs tells a denied client how many milliseconds to wait before retrying, and is null when allowed.

optionExplanations: 快照语义让它和「桶现在的状态」彻底解耦，调用方读到的永远是当时那次判定的三个值。
复用会让 remaining 和 retryAfterMs 停留在过去某次判定上，正好破坏了快照的意义。
「自动刷新」需要对象持有桶引用，那就成了可变的活视图，还得跟着桶一起加锁。
setter 有无不影响序列化输出的字段集合，字段是由数据本身决定的。
optionExplanations_en: Snapshot semantics decouple it from the bucket's current state, so callers always read the three values from that one decision.
Reusing it would freeze remaining and retryAfterMs at some past decision, destroying the snapshot meaning.
"Auto refresh" would require holding a bucket reference, making it a mutable live view that must share the bucket's lock.
Having setters or not does not change which fields serialize; the data decides that.

scenario: RateLimiter 构造时只创建了一个 defaultLimiter 实例，所有在 limiters map 里找不到配置的 endpoint 都路由到它。
scenario_en: RateLimiter builds a single defaultLimiter instance, and every endpoint missing from the limiters map routes to it.
q: 三个未配置的 endpoint 同时被打满，会看到什么？
q_en: Three unconfigured endpoints get hammered at once — what do you observe?
options: 同一个 clientId 在这三个 endpoint 上共享同一份配额
三个 endpoint 各自独立计数，互不影响，因为 key 里包含 endpoint
第一个未配置 endpoint 的请求会独占 defaultLimiter，另两个直接被拒
defaultLimiter 会为每个未知 endpoint 惰性克隆出一个副本，配额自然隔离
options_en: One clientId shares a single quota across all three endpoints.
Each endpoint counts independently because the endpoint is part of the key.
The first unconfigured endpoint monopolizes defaultLimiter and the other two are denied outright.
defaultLimiter lazily clones a copy per unknown endpoint, so quotas are isolated automatically.
why: defaultLimiter 是一个共享实例，per-key 状态只按 clientId 分桶、不区分 endpoint，同一 client 在所有未配置 endpoint 上扣同一个桶。代价是它们互相挤占额度。
why_en: The default limiter is one shared instance keyed only by clientId, so a client's traffic to any unconfigured endpoint draws down the same bucket.
tradeoff: 单个共享 default 的实现简单 vs 未配置 endpoint 之间的配额相互挤占

termDefinitions.meaning: 兜底 limiter：处理所有没有专属配置的 endpoint，保证请求不会因缺配置被直接拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The default limiter handles every endpoint without its own config so requests are never rejected merely for missing config.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识请求方的字符串，也是限流状态的分桶 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clientId is the string identifying the caller and is the key under which limiter state is bucketed.

optionExplanations: 一个实例、一张 buckets map、key 只有 clientId——三条流量在同一个桶上扣，互相挤占是必然结果。
allow(clientId, endpoint) 里 endpoint 只用于选 limiter，传给 limiter.allow 的 key 只有 clientId。
limiter 没有独占语义，三个 endpoint 都能进来；它们竞争的是配额，不是使用权。
按需克隆等于给每个未知 endpoint 建实例，那正是这个设计有意不做的事——也会让未知 endpoint 数量决定内存。
optionExplanations_en: One instance, one buckets map, keyed by clientId alone — three traffic streams draw on the same bucket, so crowding is inevitable.
In allow(clientId, endpoint) the endpoint only selects the limiter; the key passed into limiter.allow is just the clientId.
A limiter has no exclusive-ownership semantics; all three get in and compete for quota, not for access.
Cloning on demand would create an instance per unknown endpoint — exactly what this design avoids, and it lets unknown endpoints drive memory.

scenario: Sliding Window Log 为每个 key 存全部请求时间戳，精度完美但内存随请求量增长；Fixed Window Counter 只存一个计数但有窗口边界效应。
scenario_en: Sliding Window Log stores every request timestamp per key — perfect accuracy, memory grows with traffic; Fixed Window Counter stores one count but suffers boundary effects.
q: Sliding Window Counter 用哪组 per-key 状态取得中间位置？
q_en: Which per-key state lets Sliding Window Counter sit in between?
options: (currentCount, prevCount, windowStart)
(tokens, lastRefillTime)
(count, windowStart)
窗口内每一条请求都各自保留的完整时间戳列表 List<timestamp>
options_en: (currentCount, prevCount, windowStart).
(tokens, lastRefillTime).
(count, windowStart).
A List<timestamp> that keeps every request's own timestamp in the window.
why: 多存一个上一窗口的计数，就能在不保留任何时间戳的前提下把上一窗口的残留按比例算进来，缓解 Fixed Window 的边界效应。代价是它得到的是近似值，不像 Log 那样精确。
why_en: Keeping the previous window's count lets you weight in leftover traffic without storing any timestamps, softening the fixed-window boundary effect at the price of an approximation.
whenOtherWins: 当限流必须完全精确、不能容忍近似（例如按次计费的 API），仍要用 Sliding Window Log 保留全部时间戳。
tradeoff: 精度 vs 每个 key 的内存占用

termDefinitions.meaning: 滑动窗口计数器：用当前窗口和上一窗口的计数按比例估算窗口内请求数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sliding Window Counter estimates the request count by weighting the current and previous window counters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 边界效应：固定窗口切换瞬间，跨界的两波请求合起来能超出限额。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The boundary effect lets two bursts on either side of a fixed window edge together exceed the limit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 固定窗口计数器：每个固定时间窗内计数，窗口切换即清零。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fixed Window Counter counts requests inside each fixed time window and resets when the window rolls.

optionExplanations: 三个字段是常数大小，与请求量无关，却保留了「上一窗口还剩多少影响」这一位信息。
这是 Token Bucket 的状态，它建模的是可积累的突发额度，而不是窗口内的请求条数。
这正是 Fixed Window Counter：窗口一翻计数清零，两侧的突发合起来就能翻倍越限。
这是 Sliding Window Log 的状态，精度最好但内存随窗口内请求数线性增长。
optionExplanations_en: Three fields are constant size regardless of traffic, yet they retain how much the previous window still weighs.
That is Token Bucket state, which models accumulated burst allowance rather than a count inside a window.
That is Fixed Window Counter itself: the count zeroes at the roll, so bursts on both sides can double the limit.
That is Sliding Window Log state — best accuracy, but memory grows linearly with requests in the window.

scenario: 限流从单机内存搬到分布式部署，per-key 状态存进 Redis。原方案是后台线程定期扫 map、删掉一小时没访问的 key。
scenario_en: Rate limiting moves from single-node memory to a distributed setup with per-key state in Redis. The old plan was a background thread scanning the map to drop keys untouched for an hour.
q: 搬到 Redis 后，回收旧 key 该怎么做？
q_en: With Redis in place, how should stale keys be reclaimed?
options: 给 Redis key 设 TTL，让 Redis 自己过期删除
继续跑后台线程，定期 SCAN 全库并按 lastAccess 删除过期 key
改用固定容量的 LRU，在应用层维护淘汰顺序并主动删 Redis key
不回收，Redis 是外部存储、内存不属于应用进程，增长可以忽略
options_en: Set a TTL on each Redis key and let Redis expire them.
Keep a background thread that periodically SCANs the keyspace and deletes by lastAccess.
Switch to a fixed-capacity LRU, tracking eviction order in the app and deleting Redis keys itself.
Do not reclaim: Redis is external storage, so its memory is not the app's problem.
why: TTL 把回收逻辑内建在 Redis 里，应用侧一行清理代码都不用写，也没有扫描线程要调度和监控。代价是 key 过期后该 client 下次请求相当于首访，会重新拿到完整突发额度。
why_en: A TTL builds eviction into Redis itself, so the app needs no cleanup thread at all — the cost is that an expired client comes back as a first-timer with full burst capacity.
whenOtherWins: 如果必须严格控制状态条目总数（比如按固定内存预算容纳最多 N 个 key），固定容量 LRU 才能给出上界，TTL 只按时间不按数量。
tradeoff: 回收逻辑内建在存储层（零运维代码）vs 应用层自己管淘汰（可控上界）

termDefinitions.meaning: Time To Live（存活时间）：给 key 设的有效期，到期由 Redis 自动删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL stands for Time To Live: an expiry set on a key, after which Redis deletes it automatically.

termDefinitions.meaning: Least Recently Used（最近最少使用）：容量满时淘汰最久未访问的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used: when capacity is full, the entry untouched longest is evicted.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的游标式遍历命令，分批取回 key 而不阻塞服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SCAN is the Redis cursor-based command that walks keys in batches without blocking the server.

optionExplanations: 每次写状态顺带刷新 TTL，活跃 client 永不过期、静默 client 自动消失，淘汰和访问是同一次操作。
在 Redis 上重造一遍 Redis 已有的能力：SCAN 全库既费带宽，线程本身还得部署、监控、防重入。
LRU 给得出条目上限，但淘汰顺序要在应用层维护，多实例部署时这份顺序还得跨实例一致。
Redis 内存同样有限，不设过期时 key 只增不减，最终触发 Redis 自身的淘汰策略或 OOM。
optionExplanations_en: Every state write refreshes the TTL, so active clients never expire and silent ones vanish — eviction rides along with access.
This rebuilds on top of Redis what Redis already does: a full SCAN costs bandwidth, and the thread needs deploying and monitoring.
LRU does bound the entry count, but the app must maintain eviction order, and multiple instances must agree on it.
Redis memory is finite too; with no expiry, keys only grow until Redis's own eviction policy or an OOM kicks in.
codeSample:
# 每次写 per-key 限流状态时顺带续期，活跃 client 永不过期
HSET ratelimit:{clientId} tokens 42 lastRefill 1721400000000
EXPIRE ratelimit:{clientId} 3600   # 1 小时无写入即由 Redis 自动删除

# 静默一小时后 key 消失，下次请求相当于首访，重新拿到满桶
TTL ratelimit:{clientId}           # 剩余秒数，-2 表示已被回收

scenario: 配置服务会推送新规则，一次推送里可能同时改了某 endpoint 的限额、把另一个 endpoint 换了算法、还删掉了第三个 endpoint。
scenario_en: The config service pushes new rules; one push may change one endpoint's limit, switch another endpoint's algorithm, and delete a third endpoint.
q: 整体重建（reloadConfig）相比逐项更新的主要优点是什么？
q_en: What is the main advantage of a whole rebuild (reloadConfig) over per-item updates?
options: 三类变更走同一条路径，复用启动时的 factory 逻辑，没有特判代码
重建后每个 client 的已用额度都被保留，变更对使用者完全无感
重建是增量的，只有真正变化的 endpoint 会被重新创建，开销更低
重建过程中系统会短暂拒绝所有请求，从而保证新旧配置不会同时生效
options_en: All three kinds of change take one path, reusing the startup factory logic with no special cases.
Every client's consumed quota is preserved, so the change is invisible to users.
The rebuild is incremental — only genuinely changed endpoints are recreated, so it costs less.
The system briefly denies all requests during the rebuild, guaranteeing old and new config never overlap.
why: 改限额、换算法、增删 endpoint 在重建方案里都是「全部丢掉、按新配置重造再原子交换」，不需要为任何一类变更写分支。代价是所有 per-key 状态被清空——用了 90/100 token 的 client 会回到满桶。
why_en: Changing a limit, swapping an algorithm, and adding or removing endpoints all collapse into "throw everything away, rebuild, atomically swap", so no branch handles any case specially.
whenOtherWins: 如果限流是在防滥用、降限额时绝不能给滥用者清零重来，就要用保状态的 updateConfig 逐项更新。
tradeoff: 整体重建的实现简单统一 vs 保状态更新的状态连续性

termDefinitions.meaning: 原子交换：把新建好的 map 一次性替换旧引用，中间不存在半新半旧的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic swap replaces the old map reference with a fully built new one in a single step, so no half-updated state exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 工厂：根据配置里的 algorithm 字段创建对应 Limiter 实现的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The factory creates the right Limiter implementation based on the algorithm field in config.

optionExplanations: 统一路径的价值是分支数为零：新配置进来只有一种处理方式，没有「这是改值还是换算法」的判断。
恰好相反——重建丢掉全部 per-key 状态，用了 90/100 token 的 client 会拿到满桶重新开始。
重建是全量的，所有 limiter 都被丢弃重造；正因为不做差异比对，它才不需要特判代码。
原子交换的意义就是不需要停流：请求要么读到旧 map，要么读到新 map，没有拒绝窗口。
optionExplanations_en: The value of one path is zero branches: new config has exactly one handling, with no "is this a value change or an algorithm swap" test.
The opposite is true — a rebuild drops all per-key state, so a client at 90 of 100 tokens restarts with a full bucket.
The rebuild is wholesale; every limiter is discarded and recreated, and skipping diffing is precisely why it needs no special cases.
The point of the atomic swap is that no traffic pause is needed: a request reads either the old map or the new one.
